scenes.voice: Your API works fine, then requests start timing out. Often it's the connection pool.
Opening a database connection is slow, so apps keep a small pool and reuse connections.

lines.t: so reuse them from a pool

scenes.voice: When every connection is busy, requests wait. Slow queries make the line longer, and waiting requests time out.
Always give connections back, even when the query fails.
scenes.code:
conn = pool.acquire()
try:
    run_query(conn)
finally:
    pool.release(conn)

scenes.voice: A bigger pool isn't always the fix. Fix slow queries first. Save this for the next time it breaks.
